payload.title: Integrate canonical Harness truth boundary, fresh materializer repairs and profile truth-gate latency
payload.work_clay: Re-read newest Frank main and Draft PR #25 plus VPS_UBUNTU_TRUTH_GATE_RECEIPT.json. Preserve the confirmed finding that direct legacy Harness mutation can bypass repo/materialization truth on stale ClayGraph. Integrate fail-closed preflight at the unavoidable canonical Harness state-access boundary or retire the raw legacy entrypoint; do not rely permanently on wrapper/operator convention. Reconcile the two independently exposed fresh-install repairs: an idempotent epoch-0 genesis row for separately authorized empty materialization and typed entity/person replay into the entities projection without weakening ClayGraph foreign keys. Prefer moving typed projection into the authoritative semantic materializer implementation if review confirms that boundary. Re-run the full empty-state -> authorized create -> admitted repo replay -> graph rebuild -> repo truth PASS -> Harness smoke -> GRAPH_STALE/MATERIALIZATION_STALE/SCHEMA_MIGRATION_REQUIRED/CONTINUITY_DEGRADED lesions -> zero mutation -> rescue PASS cycle against the newest main on the self-hosted Ubuntu runner. Then profile truth-gate component latency separately: process startup, git fetch, remote/head/ancestor checks, critical-file hashes, UnifiedDB checks, ClayGraph checks, guarded read and guarded mutation. Do not weaken or cache the truth gate until a separately falsified freshness-receipt design exists. Run a disposable compatibility matrix for trusted_schema=OFF and SQLITE_DBCONFIG_DEFENSIVE across migrations, semantic replay, graph projection, FTS/extensions, prompt capsule, Harness and recovery. Keep the real-Qwen4B shadow lane separate: its latest persisted receipt remains FAIL/real_model_executed=false and must not be counted as a Harness or release PASS.
payload.reason_clay: Self-hosted Ubuntu experiments confirmed the legacy Harness stale-state mutation bypass: direct stale-graph open-hyperposition exited 0 and wrote one row, while the guarded equivalent returned GRAPH_STALE/75 with zero mutation. The same clean-install cycle exposed missing genesis epoch and missing typed entity/person projection; both candidate repairs passed targeted regressions and full disposable Ubuntu replay. Four real truth-failure classes now fail closed with zero guarded mutation and restore to PASS. Warm full truth preflight is roughly 0.5 s while independent host-local FULL SQLite commits are sub-2 ms, supporting but not proving that repo/process/network validation dominates latency. Newest main is moving concurrently and newest real-Qwen4B shadow evidence is still FAIL, so integration and model work must remain separately adjudicated.
payload.completion_clay: Newest-main integration is complete only when no canonical Harness entry can mutate without a current truth PASS; authorized fresh materialization from empty files reaches admitted semantic replay plus CURRENT ClayGraph; the four real lesion classes return expected exit classes with zero mutation; restoration returns PASS; wider regressions pass; component latency distributions are recorded without weakening safety; SQLite hardening receives an explicit compatibility verdict; final result is fed back to frank/harness/unifieddb/claygraph/claycode/gwt/emergenz/hyperposition/clayresearch. This work does not by itself claim BASE/H1/release or Andreas-machine acceptance.
payload.executor_policy: Use an actually connected current Ubuntu execution surface for runtime receipts. Re-read newest remote main immediately before patching and before final test. Preserve append-only negative evidence and concurrent-worker provenance. Claude research capacity is currently recorded as temporarily unavailable; when it returns, it must ingest this exact VPS receipt/report and newest main before adjudicating integration. Hostinger Ubuntu runner evidence is valid remote build/test evidence but final Frank v0.1 release acceptance remains Andreas' actual Ubuntu developer system.
